snippet.title: VANTAGE TACTICS - Gameplay Preview 2
snippet.description:
Early gameplay preview of Vantage Tatics. This is a turn based tactical game with MOBA elements. Release date and platform TBD.

This gameplay recording features a new map called Volcanic Caldera. It also features and some ability updates.

If you are interested in following the development of Vantage Tactics, please add it to your wishlist on Steam and consider joining the mailing list and Discord server.
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5518100/Vantage_Tactics
- Mailing list: https://www.vantagetactics.com/mailing-list
- Discord: https://discord.gg/ha7TMDqdS
